messages:
samir: Alerting that gpu-attach latency rose sharply in us-west2 around 11:10 UTC; attach failures at ~10%. provisioner logs show 'attach_wait_disk' and NVMe timeouts.
ciara: any recent maintenance, firmware, or janitor changes in that region?
devon: we pushed a thermal firmware tweak to a small cohort at 11:00 and enabled a more aggressive scrub-window to reclaim hotblocks at 11:02 (scrub.concurrency=7).
samir: grabbing iostat from host gw-usw2-102 (one of the failing hosts):
```
Device       r/s     w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1      0.0  285.4    0.0 22832    80.0    14.50  48.8  0.11  98.9
```
ciara: %util ~99, avgqu ~14. scrub + vendor thermal FW change might be triggering longer write command latencies on this drive family.
ops-bot: flag-change detected: "scrub.concurrency" 3 -> 7 by infra-deploy at 11:02 UTC.
devon: also telemetry shows nvme.temp spiking on the cohort right after the FW flip, which could increase internal controller retries and latency.
samir: host dmesg has repeated: "nvme io timeout, recovery attempted" around 11:08-11:12 UTC.
ciara: mitigation plan: 1) revert scrub.concurrency to 3 for us-west2; 2) pause thermal firmware cohort rollout; 3) set vm.dirty_ratio=5 vm.dirty_bytes=33554432 on affected hosts; 4) route new GPU launches to us-west1 for 30m (policy 'avoid:us-west2').
devon: rolling flag flip now: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"key":"scrub.concurrency","value":"3","scope":"us-west2"}'`
ops-bot: flag-change detected: "scrub.concurrency" 7 -> 3 by infra-deploy at 11:18 UTC.
samir: after patching first 25% hosts, attach failures dropped 10.2% -> 1.9% in ~6 minutes. strong signal.
ciara: followups: 1) audit FW telemetry and revert if thermal thresholds cause higher controller retry rates; 2) run a staging test that applies vendor FW change + scrub load to catch latency amplification; 3) add alert when nvme.temp_delta > 6C AND nvme.%util > 85% correlates with attach_errors.
devon: filing STORAGE-561 with timeline, host iostats, dmesg, and FW artifact.
oncall-sre: incident INC-2026-200 opened and paging storage + release. please push exact host list and attach-provision traces to the incident doc. :rotating_light: :eyes:
